stats.fact: Cursor Pro plan includes $20 monthly credit pool for frontier model usage; Auto mode usage is unlimited and does not deplete credits
Annual billing saves approximately 17-20% (Pro drops from $20/month to ~$16/month), saving ~$48/year
Cursor student discount offers 1 full year of Cursor Pro free (worth $240) to verified .edu email university students in North America
Claude Opus burns credits roughly 20x faster than Gemini Flash; $20 buys ~700 Flash requests vs. only ~34 Opus prompts
Max Mode uses token-based pricing at the model's full API rate with a 20% surcharge, so a single complex task (150 tool calls, 200K input, 20K output tokens) costs $3-8
Three heavy agent tasks per day with Max Mode can cost $9-24/day, or $180-500/month above the subscription fee
Heavy individual users reported monthly overages of 15-30% above subscription cost; in documented cases entire annual subscriptions were depleted in a single day

In early 2025, Cursor changed premium request cost for several models from 1x to 20x without prominent announcement; Cursor issued public apology on July 4, 2025, offering refunds for charges from mid-June to early July
Cursor Teams added Premium seats ($120/seat/month, 5x Standard usage) in June 2026 update for predictability
GitHub Copilot Pro at $10/month is considered the best value competitor offering 300 premium requests, coding agent, code review, and multi-model support
Optimizing .cursorrules files (removing unnecessary text) can reduce input token cost by 10-30% per request
Auto mode picks cost-efficient models priced at ~$0.25/M tokens (cache read), $1.25/M (input), $6.00/M (output)
